result.title: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Task-Free Federated Continual Forecasting via Two-Tier Replay under Concept Drift
result.comment: Peer-reviewed and accepted for presentation at the AGCS 2026 conference
result.summary: Federated time-series forecasting is increasingly important in applications where temporal data are distributed across privacy-sensitive clients, such as environmental monitoring, smart cities, and industrial sensing. A central limitation of current continual-learning protocols is that they usually assume predefined task boundaries, whereas deployed forecasting systems receive an uninterrupted stream and must decide autonomously when adaptation is necessary. This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in task-free federated forecasting under concept drift. We introduce a drift-aware continual-learning protocol in which each client monitors prediction-window RMSE, calibrates a robust median threshold from the offline base period, and triggers adaptation only after persistent degradation. To mitigate forgetting, we propose a TwoTierReplay mechanism that separates fixed offline representative memory from online memory. The offline tier preserves long-term knowledge learned during the base phase, while the online tier captures recent distributional changes after drift. Experiments on the Beijing Multi-Site Air- Quality dataset with 12 clients, three forecasting targets, and three horizons show that TwoTierReplay achieves the best stability-plasticity score in all nine target-horizon configurations. It improves over the strongest baseline by approximately 11.4%. These results suggest that explicit temporal structuring of replay memory is a practical and effective mechanism for task-free federated continual forecasting.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究无任务边界的联邦时序预测中的灾难性遗忘，提出以预测窗口 RMSE 触发自适应的漂移感知协议，并设计分离离线固定记忆与在线近期记忆的双层回放机制。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时触发状态更新」的阈值判据与长期/近期双层记忆结构，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的保留、更新时机及类似 LOOK/STOP 的决策提供概念线索，但需核查其单变量误差统计与视觉证据筛选的差异。
